Name: TerrainAO
Label: Terrain Ambient Occlusion
Description: Controls the terrain ambient-occlusion cache used to add local contact shading.

Params.Name: TerrainAOEnabled
Params.Label: Enable Terrain AO
Params.Description: Enable ambient occlusion calculated from the terrain heightfield.

Params.Name: TerrainAORadiusFactor
Params.Label: AO Radius (Terrain Scale)
Params.Description: Sampling radius for terrain ambient occlusion, expressed as a fraction of the terrain scale.
